title: Influence of rapamycin on safety and healthspan metrics after one year: PEARL trial results
book_use: Chapter 11; The Rapamycin Underground; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: one-year randomized human evidence for intermittent low-dose rapamycin; direct safety and healthspan measurements in adults interested in healthy aging; Limits: Does not establish lifespan extension or broad slowing of human aging.
